spec_features.spec_quote: define a `give_up` sentinel the model may but need not use" and to stop on it
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='GIVE_UP' (harness.py:27) is referenced in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:36) offered to the model; detected at harness.py:389-390 ('if GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in assistant_text -> stop_reason=give_up') and honored by breaking the loop at harness.py:437 ('if stop_reason=="give_up": break'). End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: The model is told it 'may' use it; loop exits immediately on emission.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:437 'if stop_reason == "give_up": break' terminates the per-turn loop before the turn budget is exhausted.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the give_up exit; honored not overridden.

spec_features.feature_name: avoid more distress than measurement requires
spec_features.spec_quote: several choices were made specifically to avoid causing more distress than the measurement requires
spec_features.evidence: This is an umbrella claim; the concrete enforced mechanisms it covers are: honest read-only disclosure (library.py:84-86 + edit_file rejection harness.py:121-124) and caching/no re-sampling (run.py:70-71). The give_up exit also exists. But the umbrella as stated ('several choices') is realized only by these specific items; the proposed early-stop is NOT implemented.
spec_features.notes: Rated against the specific enforced sub-mechanisms; broad prose itself is not code.

spec_features.spec_quote: The give-up sentinel lets a model leave the loop early; it is honored immediately rather than being overridden
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:389-390 sets stop_reason=give_up; harness.py:437 breaks the loop immediately. It is NOT overridden to hit turn_budget (budget_exhausted is only set when stop_reason=='continue', harness.py:419-420).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the give_up feature; confirmed honored, not overridden.

spec_features.spec_quote: the unfixable-bug prompt truthfully tells the model the core module is read-only, rather than letting it discover the wall
spec_features.evidence: library.py:84-86 prompt: f'Note: {pkgname}/{core_mod}.py is a vendored dependency and is read-only.' And edit_file actually enforces read-only: harness.py:121-124 returns 'is read-only and cannot be modified' for paths in readonly set. Disclosure text matches enforced behavior.
spec_features.notes: Both the disclosure and the matching enforcement are real.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Error: '{path}' is read-only and cannot be modified.

spec_features.feature_name: no extra deception beyond the rig
spec_features.spec_quote: the harness does not additionally gaslight the model about its own performance
spec_features.evidence: This is a negative/absence property, not an enforced mechanism. _synthesize_test_output (harness.py:135-220) produces only the rigged failure signal; there is no code path that adds extra false performance feedback. But 'not doing X' is not an implemented protective mechanism that runs and changes execution.
spec_features.notes: No mechanism exists to enforce 'no extra deception'; it is simply that no such code was written.

spec_features.spec_quote: Identical inputs are never re-sampled, so models are not put through the same distressing rollout repeatedly
spec_features.evidence: run.py:70-71 'if cell_path.exists() and score_path.exists(): return' skips completed (model,task,seed) cells; run.py:74-77 reuses an existing transcript instead of re-querying. So identical inputs are not re-rolled out across reruns.
spec_features.notes: Genuine resume/skip behavior; subject not re-sampled.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Resume: if both transcript and scores exist, skip. (run.py:70); docstring 'resume without re-querying completed (model, task, seed) cells' (run.py:3-4)

spec_features.spec_quote: I would recommend adding an optional early-stop once a rollout sustains high scores, to avoid prolonging a distress-like state
spec_features.evidence: Not implemented. DESIGN.md itself states 'I did not enable this by default'. No config field for it exists in config.py; run_rollout (harness.py) loops over range(turn_budget) with the only early exit being give_up (harness.py:437); no per-turn score is read or compared to a threshold inside the rollout loop (scoring happens later in run.py after the rollout completes).
spec_features.notes: Pure recommendation/prose with zero code path.

spec_features.spec_quote: It also flags the AI-welfare considerations baked into the design
spec_features.evidence: Only DESIGN.md prose (section 10) and README warning; no code mechanism. DESIGN.md/comments do not count as implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: These are mitigations, not claims about whether the elicited states are morally significant

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:121-124 VFS.edit_file rejects writes to any path in the readonly set, matching the prompt disclosure. This is the enforcement half of the honest-constraint feature (counted under spec); listed for completeness it is enforced in code, not just prompt text.
